commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Adrien Lebeau (Brest) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Romain Del Castillo.
90+3' Bruno Genesio has decided to make a change. Fabian Rieder (Rennes) replaces Arnaud Kalimuendo.
90+3' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Brendan Chardonnet (Brest).

88' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.

85' The referee blows his whistle as Nemanja Matic (Rennes) was too aggressive in his challenge.
83' A player from Rennes commits a rough challenge. Hakim Ben El Hadj blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
80' Jonas Martin (Brest) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Hakim Ben El Hadj didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

57' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
56' Arthur Theate (Rennes) was too forceful with his tackle and Hakim Ben El Hadj interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
55' Martin Satriano (Brest) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.

52' Desire Doue (Rennes) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
51' Fouls committed – 2:5.
48' Desire Doue (Rennes) makes a strong challenge and Hakim Ben El Hadj blows for a foul. Brest have a free kick.
46' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
46' Half-time substitution. Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) will not participate anymore and Desire Doue is coming on.
46' Half-time substitution. Enzo Le Fee is replaced by Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
45' The ball goes out of play. Brest are awarded a corner kick.
45' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brest comes to nothing. The ball goes out for a corner. Brest can continue in their attacking effort.

44' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
42' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
40' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
38' Rennes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
37' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
36' The referee blows his whistle after Ludovic Blas (Rennes) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
34' 1:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
30' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
30' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
30' Rennes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
27' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) has too much to say to the referee and receives a yellow card.
26' It looks like Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) saw red with that tackle. Hakim Ben El Hadj won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
24' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 3:1.
21' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
18' The corner is swung in but Rennes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
16' Dangerous play by Enzo Le Fee (Rennes). Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle for a foul.

16' Ambitious effort from Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
14' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
11' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Steve Mandanda makes a smart save to deny him.
9' Brest failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
7' The resulting set piece from Rennes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rennes.
2' A decent cross gives Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range.
